# Shorelight

> > Shorelight connects international students with U.S. university pathways, providing guidance on F-1 visas, OPT/CPT work authorization, and navigating American higher education.

Shorelight partners with U.S. universities to support international student recruitment and success. The site offers comprehensive resources on visa requirements (F-1, SEVIS), work authorization programs (OPT, CPT), application processes, and policy updates affecting international student mobility, with particular focus on students from India and other key markets.

## Key Topics

- F-1 visa requirements and application
- Optional Practical Training (OPT)
- Curricular Practical Training (CPT)
- SEVIS and Student Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP)
- International student visa policy
- U.S. university admissions for international students
- Student visa trends and issuance data
- USCIS and Department of State regulations
- Higher education policy impact
- International student mobility
- Master's degree programs
- Study abroad guidance
- University partnerships
- Student work authorization

## Visa and Immigration Essentials

- [F-1 Visa for International Students in 2026: Requirements, Rules, Status](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/student-visa-usa-f1): Complete F-1 visa guide: requirements, SEVP rules & application process
- [CPT vs OPT: What Is the Difference and How to Apply](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/how-do-international-students-apply-for-cpt-and-opt-status): CPT vs OPT comparison guide for F-1 visa work authorization applications
- [US Visa Social Media Vetting in 2026](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/us-visa-social-media-vetting): US visa social media screening requirements for F-1, M-1, J-1 applicants
- [Student Visa Issuances Were Already Dropping](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/student-visa-issuances-were-already-dropping): Shorelight Analytics examines declining F/M/J visa trends from India & US

## Policy and Industry Analysis

## University Admissions and Academic Life

- [What Types of Professors Will I Have at a US University?](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/what-will-my-professors-be-like-at-a-us-university): Guide to US professor types, tenure system & academic roles for students
- [Asynchronous: Meaning, How It Works for International Students, and More](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/studying-on-your-schedule-what-asynchronous-learning-means-for-international): Asynchronous learning explained: Canvas, Blackboard & flexible study options
- [Missed a Deadline? Here's What to Do](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/missed-a-deadline-heres-what-to-do): Solutions for missed university application & financial aid deadlines
- [3 Reasons to Start Your Freshman Year in Spring](https://shorelight.com/student-stories/3-reasons-to-start-your-freshman-year-in-spring): Benefits of January spring semester admission for international students
